title: Contain a service busy loop
preconditions: Confirm elevated CPU and busy-loop log records
Identify the service emitting the busy-loop records
investigation: Compare current CPU with the service CPU limit
Inspect service state and downstream error propagation

remediation.reason: Restart the service owning the busy loop to restore request processing

follow_up: Restart is containment. Profile the busy path and fix the loop before the next deployment.
